svg.title: A caregiver's day, step by step
svg.desc: Eight everyday actions in order: sign in, build the inventory, check the dashboard, update a quantity, order supplies, mark the order received, add it to stock, and ask the assistant. Each card names the screen, the API call and what changes in the database. Writes always go to the server first.
svg.text: A caregiver's day, step by step

svg.text: GET /items unless the cache is fresh;
ai_usage (and consent) rows only if Groq
is used; never inventory or orders
Writes go to the server first. After a successful write the
phone invalidates the affected lists and fetches them
again; another phone's changes appear after the next
The app shows the last data it loaded, labelled as
such. Every save fails until the phone is back online;
